title: The Northern Pavilion Elders
summary: After Shen Yun's self-destruction, Han Fei, watching with his granddaughters, decides he will help Xiao Yan if needed. Xiao Yan catches the trace of soul Shen Yun let slip away and destroys it. Han Fei comes out to meet him, thanks him for helping the Han family, and warns him to leave the Central Plains. Xiao Yan promises Tian Huo Zun Zhe that he will take the Mighty Huang Pill to reach Dou Zong and refine a new body for him. At the Wind Lightning Pavilion's Northern Pavilion, Shen Yun's Spiritual Lightning Tablet shatters, and Elder Dian, Elder Lei and Elder Feng surround the Han Manor to draw out his killer. Xiao Yan comes back in a black robe on his Bone Wings, and the three elders and Hong Tian Xiao trap him inside the Nine Heavenly Lightning Prison Formation. He vows to fight until the Han Clan is free, and the elders open with Wind Blade and Lightning Slash.
events: Han Fei resolves to help Xiao Yan after Shen Yun's death.
Xiao Yan destroys the trace of soul Shen Yun tried to save.
Han Fei introduces himself and warns Xiao Yan about the Wind Lightning Pavilion.
Xiao Yan promises Tian Huo Zun Zhe a new body and plans to take the Mighty Huang Pill.
Shen Yun's Spiritual Lightning Tablet shatters at the Northern Pavilion.
Elder Dian, Elder Lei and Elder Feng besiege the Han Manor.
Xiao Yan arrives to free the Han family and faces the three elders.
The Heaven Hall disciples form the Nine Heavenly Lightning Prison Formation and the fight begins.
